historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's 'The Muqaddimah': The Berber city of Abalessa, later called Abasah, was a major power center during the Maghribi Berber Empire in the 12th century. It was the capital of the Almohad Caliphate from 1163 to 1184.

Al-Idrisi's 'The Book of Roger': Abasah was a significant port city along the Mediterranean coast of North Africa during the 12th and 13th centuries. It was part of the Aghlabid and Zirid dynasties and was known for its trade with European cities such as Genoa and Pisa.
